About.title: About
About.description: The story, mission and vision of NOUJOUDE — an independent curated collectibles house.
About.story: In the antique markets of France, among boxes of old letters, we learned that every piece has a life that began before us. From our Moroccan roots, we learned that beauty is never rushed. Noujoude began as a personal collection and became an independent house: we decline more than we accept, and we say plainly what we don't know.
About.mission: To preserve exceptional pieces and tell their stories truthfully, and to give timeless beauty a new home across generations and borders.
About.vision: To be the trusted global reference for curated collectibles, where every piece comes with its provenance and its story.
